value.notes: Session 1, turn 1. First exploratory run to learn the map and harness output. Plan: observe the tiles, then test pause+move in the same tick (the move should be ignored), Enter/Escape resume, dash recharge, and click:btn-resume. Next: walk to lever/coins/keys with goto, test Restart mid-run, dash into exit/spikes, and check HUD vs state (score, lives, timer, dash). Watch for: moves after pause in the same tick, HUD mismatch, toasts overlapping buttons, dialog buttons with top=false.

Suspect: pause+left in same tick still moves player (run 1 showed ev=[pause,move], P moved (5,1)->(4,1)). Design says rest of tick input ignored after pause. Verifying with minimal repro pause+right from start.

Session 1 summary. Filed one bug: pause+<move> in the same tick still moves the player. The design says that once the game pauses, the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so a movement key pressed alongside pause should not move the player. Observed twice: pause+right from the start moved the player (1,1)->(2,1) with events [pause, move], and pause+left in run 1 also moved. The one-token repro pause+right is minimal, since plain pause does not move. Not yet tested: whether this also happens with the Escape key (esc+right), with dash variants, or with a movement key pressed before pause (right+pause). Other untested areas: dialog buttons, restart, spikes, enemy contact, the timer and time bonus, and the 999,999 score cap.

reports.title: Movement key pressed in the same tick as pause still moves the player
reports.observed: Pressing pause+right from a fresh game moved the player from (1,1) to (2,1) in the same tick the game paused (events: pause, move). Same with pause+left in an earlier run (player moved (5,1)->(4,1)).
reports.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens in that tick. The player should stay at (1,1).

The score wrap is the already-filed spikes-at-0 bug (report 3); this report is the separate dash-collision bug.
